svg.title: From folders to four places
svg.desc: Traditional email: a mail client with a long tree of nested folders across six inboxes (Exchange, Gmail, Outlook.com, iCloud, a university IMAP account and an old Yahoo account), with unread counts, sync errors and conflicts everywhere. MiniMail: four filter buttons (Inbox, Archive, Trash and Spam) and, apart from them, Sent and Drafts.

g.text: Mailbox 98% full · 12 sync issues · Click to fix
Folders to build, nest and keep tidy.
Four places. The rest sorts itself.
